text: {"claims":[{"quote":"Revenue crossed INR 285 billion milestone, growing 29% year-on-year","metric":"revenue growth","promised":"29% revenue growth for FY26","horizon":"FY26"},{"quote":"EBITDA grew faster than revenue, increasing by 35% year-on-year with margins expanding to 13.9%","metric":"margin","promised":"EBITDA margin of 13.9% for FY26","horizon":"FY26"},{"quote":"Capital expenditure for the quarter stood at INR3.9 billion, taking the total capex for full financial year to approximately INR14.8 billion","metric":"capex","promised":"FY26 capex of INR14.8 billion","horizon":"FY26"},{"quote":"We remain on track to execute our planned capex program of INR 60 billion to INR 80 billion over the next 5 years","metric":"capex","promised":"Capex program of INR60-80 billion over next 5 years","horizon":"next 5 years"},{"quote":"We also increased our dividend payout to approximately 27.2%, up from 26.3% last year as we move steadily towards our stated objective of exceeding 30% by FY 2030","metric":"other","promised":"Dividend payout of >30% by FY2030","horizon":"FY2030"},{"quote":"We remain firm on track to achieve our target of greater than 10% contribution from exports by financial year 2030","metric":"other","promised":"Export contribution >10% by FY2030","horizon":"FY2030"},{"quote":"Progressing towards our EBITDA margin goal of 8% to 10% by FY2030","metric":"margin","promised":"EBITDA margin of 8-10% by FY2030","horizon":"FY2030"},{"quote":"Within the Wires & Cable segment, growth since the launch of this program has consistently exceeded our guidance, tracking at 1.5x to 2x of the industry growth with margins remaining far above the guided range","metric":"growth","promised":"Growth of 1.5x-2x industry growth in Wires & Cable segment","horizon":"ongoing"}]}
